verdict.rationale: Inngest documents built-in metrics, traces, and per-step timing in its own platform. However, nothing in the pack shows exporting failure rates, latencies, or queue depths to an external observability stack, or any alerting on misbehaving workflows. The in-platform metrics dashboard and REST API are adjacent features or building blocks, not the export-and-alert capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, failure rates, latencies, and queue depths export to my observability stack, and alerts fire when workflows misbehave
